UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Registered farmer profile with auto-fetched device Google account credentials and farming preferences

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID matching request.auth.uid

email.description: Google email address auto-fetched from device account

displayName.description: Farmer or user display name from Google Account

photoUrl.description: Optional profile photo URL from Google Account

detectedAez.description: Current detected Agro-Ecological Zone number (1 to 30)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account profile was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account profile was last updated

FertilizerRecord.title: FertilizerRecord
FertilizerRecord.description: Saved BARC FRG-2024 fertilizer calculation record for a farmer's plot

userId.description: UID of the farmer who generated this calculation

cropName.description: English name of the selected crop

landArea.description: Entered land area in specified units

landUnit.description: Unit of land measurement (DECIMAL, BIGHA, KATHA, ACRE, HECTARE)

cowdungTonnesPerHa.description: Organic cowdung manure rate in tonnes per hectare

totalCostTk.description: Total estimated fertilizer cost in BDT

aezNumber.description: Agro-Ecological Zone number where calculation applies

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the calculation was saved

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the calculation record was last updated

/users/{userId}.description: Farmer profiles keyed by Firebase Auth UID

/users/{userId}/calculations/{calcId}.description: Saved fertilizer calculation records per farmer
